llm.summary: This skill is purpose-aligned for Dataify ChatGPT collection, but it can automatically send prompts or ChatGPT URLs to a third-party paid API with broad implicit invocation enabled.

dimensions.detail: External API use is expected for this skill, but the artifacts do not prominently warn users that prompts, URLs, and collected result data are sent to Dataify before the task is submitted.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No installer or package mutation behavior was found. The Python helper is a thin wrapper around a shared dataify-task-operations catalog builder that is not included in this artifact, so runtime behavior depends on that companion component.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill enables implicit invocation and says clear low-risk, low-cost requests may execute immediately without confirmation, even though execution submits user prompts or ChatGPT URLs to an external Dataify endpoint and may consume credits.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill documents persistent DATAIFY_API_TOKEN setup in shell profile or user environment storage. This is common for API tooling and not a backdoor, but it stores a long-lived credential outside the skill.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose matches the artifact: collect ChatGPT answers by URL or search term through Dataify and return answer text, citations, links, prompts, timestamps, and URLs.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review before installing. Use this only when you intentionally want Dataify to process the ChatGPT URL or prompt, and avoid confidential prompts or private conversation links unless that transfer is acceptable. Prefer session-scoped token setup when possible, and monitor credit usage because successful collection is billed.
llm.findings:
[TP4] expected: The helper script is a generic Dataify catalog-builder wrapper rather than a ChatGPT-specific scraper, but this is consistent with a skill that submits Dataify catalog tasks instead of implementing scraping locally.
[YR1] expected: The matched shell-profile command only persists DATAIFY_API_TOKEN for user configuration; it is not artifact-backed evidence of malware persistence, SSH key injection, or a backdoor.
[SQP-1] unexpected: The concern is valid in context: allow_implicit_invocation is enabled while the skill can submit paid external collection tasks, so activation is broader than ideal for sensitive or billable data transfer.
[SQP-2] unexpected: The workflow shows external transmission through Dataify, but the privacy boundary is not made prominent before collecting user prompts or ChatGPT URLs.
[SQP-3] expected: Chinese tool labels are awkward in the English skill text but do not indicate security-relevant hidden behavior.
[E1] expected: The external curl submission is central to the Dataify collection purpose, but it remains a privacy and billing boundary users should understand.
[EA2] expected: The flagged phrasing appears in account-token handling guidance such as not asking users to paste tokens into chat; it does not show autonomous destructive or high-impact local actions.
